claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Witness photos show multiple black rectangular electronic devices on a “McSteve Online Gadget Store” branded bag; no PS4 Pro console shape, controller, ports, or console branding is visible.

risks.risk: Item type mismatch / bait-and-switch risk (photos appear to be power-bank/charger-like gadgets, not a PS4 Pro console).
risks.proof: A clear shot of the exact device showing PS4 Pro identifiers (PS4 logo, model number like CUH-7xxx, and the console’s front/top ports) plus a photo of the controller showing its model/branding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unrelated/unknown black gadget (worst case: generic used power/charging device with unknown specs), not as a PS4 Pro.

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/specs and output ratings (if these are power banks/chargers).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the label/specs sticker on each unit (mAh/W, output voltage/current, charging standard).
risks.if_unproven: Price as low/unknown-spec used chargers/power gadgets with no guarantee of performance.

risks.risk: Condition risk (scratches, dents, battery health, port wear).
risks.proof: One close-up per unit of: charging port(s), any display/indicators, and the textured surface for damage; plus a test/indicator shot (e.g., charging LED behavior).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible defects/limited lifespan.

risks.risk: Accessory completeness risk (cables, charger, controller, manuals, warranty/receipt).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included items laid out (cables, adapters, controller, box/manuals) and any receipt/warranty documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst case: no essential accessories).

risks.risk: Quantity/individual unit risk (stacked units may be mixed models or different conditions).
risks.proof: A shot showing each unit’s label/model number (or at least 2–3 representative units) and a count confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-condition/lowest-spec unit among the lot.

proof_requests: Send clear photos that identify the exact item as a PS4 Pro console: front/top view, visible PS logo, and the model number label (e.g., CUH-7xxx).
Send a clear photo of the controller showing brand/model and all ports/buttons in focus.
If the items are actually power banks/chargers: send close-ups of the label/specs (mAh/W, output ratings, charging standards) and a test shot showing charging/LED indicators.
Show what accessories are included (power cable/charging cable, controller cable if any, box/manuals, receipt/warranty).
response.reason: The witness photos do not match the seller’s claim of a PS4 Pro console; the device type and specs are not verifiable from the provided images. Proof is required to confirm what the buyer would actually receive.
